title:
ORGANA: A robotic assistant for automated
chemistry experimentation and characterization

metadata.authors: Kourosh Darvish, Marta Skreta, Yuchi Zhao, Naruki Yoshikawa, Sagnik Som, Miroslav Bogdanovic, Yang Cao, Han Hao, Haoping Xu, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Animesh Garg, Florian Shkurti

source_summary: ORGANA is an AI-driven robotic system that automates and streamlines chemistry lab procedures through natural language interaction, reducing manual effort and increasing efficiency for scientists.
abstract: Chemistry experiments often demand significant time and effort, particularly for repetitive tasks. We present ORGANA, an assistive robotic system that automates a variety of lab procedures using AI-driven decision-making and perception tools. ORGANA interacts with chemists via natural language to clarify goals, handle disambiguation, and provide updates about experiments. Additionally, by automating complex tasks and enabling parallel execution, ORGANA reduces physical demand and frees up significant time for scientists, paving the way for more efficient and adaptable lab automation.
